svg.title: Thoracic cage, anterior view
svg.desc: Sternum (manubrium, body, xiphoid process) with 12 rib pairs and costal cartilages, anterior view. Patient right is on the viewer's left. True ribs 1-7 reach the sternum, false ribs 8-10 join the cartilage above, and ribs 11-12 float. Clavicles omitted.
